description: This Java source file defines the PermissionController class, which handles HTTP requests related to permission management in the web admin interface of a sales management application. It includes methods for displaying permission pages and paginating permission data, and interacts with various services for permissions, groups, and countries.

classes.name: PermissionController
classes.description: Controller class handling admin permission management HTTP requests, including displaying permission management pages and providing paginated permission data.

methods.description: Handles GET requests to display the permission management page; currently unimplemented, throws an exception.
